description: WMOC performs method-of-characteristics transient simulations, with INP networks, pump and valve operations, bursts and leaks. This resource is provided by GitContainer (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: MIT; README also mentions Revised BSD, unresolved wording conflict. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The project calls version 0.1.0 a pre-release. The page contains both MIT and Revised BSD licence statements, which need reconciliation. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
